```{python}
#| echo: false
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import HTML

def render_tikz(tikz_code: str, scale: float = 1.25) -> HTML:
    """Compiles a TikZ snippet to an inline SVG using latex + dvisvgm."""
    tex_doc = f"""\\documentclass[dvisvgm,tikz,border=6pt]{{standalone}}
\\usepackage{{amsmath,amssymb}}
\\usepackage{{tikz}}
\\begin{{document}}
{tikz_code}
\\end{{document}}
"""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
        tmp_path = Path(tmpdir)
        tex_file = tmp_path / "diagram.tex"
        dvi_file = tmp_path / "diagram.dvi"
        svg_file = tmp_path / "diagram.svg"
        tex_file.write_text(tex_doc, encoding="utf-8")

        subprocess.run(
            ["latex", "-interaction=nonstopmode", "-halt-on-error", "diagram.tex"],
            cwd=tmpdir,
            check=True,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        )
        subprocess.run(
            ["dvisvgm", "--no-fonts", f"-Z {scale}", "diagram.dvi", "-o", "diagram.svg"],
            cwd=tmpdir,
            check=True,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        )
        svg_content = svg_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    return HTML(f'<div style="text-align: center; margin: 1.2rem 0;">{svg_content}</div>')
```

## Problem Set

### Problem 1 (Lecture Problem 5)
Two cables exert forces $F_B = 600\text{ lb}$ and $F_C = 750\text{ lb}$ on the hook at $A(0, 0, 4\text{ ft})$, anchored at $B(3\text{ ft}, -3\text{ ft}, 2.5\text{ ft})$ and $C(2\text{ ft}, 4\text{ ft}, 0\text{ ft})$. Determine the magnitude and coordinate direction angles of the resultant force acting at $A$.

```{python}
#| echo: false
render_tikz(r"""
\begin{tikzpicture}[x={(-0.55cm,-0.42cm)}, y={(1cm,0cm)}, z={(0cm,1cm)}, scale=0.78, >=stealth, line cap=round, line join=round, font=\small]
  % Shaded floor triangle for C
  \fill[gray!15] (0,0,0) -- (2,4,0) -- (0,4,0) -- cycle;

  % Axes
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (4.8,0,0) node[below left] {$x$};
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (0,5.2,0) node[right] {$y$};
  \draw[dashed, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (0,-3.8,0) node[left] {$-y$};
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (0,0,5.0) node[above] {$z$};

  % Coordinate construction lines for B(3, -3, 2.5)
  \draw[dashed, gray] (3,0,0) -- (3,-3,0) -- (0,-3,0);
  \draw[dashed, gray] (3,-3,0) -- (3,-3,2.5);
  \draw[dashed, gray] (0,0,4) -- (0,-3,4) -- (0,-3,0);

  % Coordinate construction lines for C(2, 4, 0)
  \draw[dashed, gray] (2,0,0) -- (2,4,0) -- (0,4,0);

  % Dimension labels
  \node[above, font=\footnotesize] at (0,-1.5,4) {$3\text{ ft}$};
  \node[left, font=\footnotesize] at (0,0,2.2) {$4\text{ ft}$};
  \node[below left, font=\footnotesize] at (1.5,-3,0) {$3\text{ ft}$};
  \node[left, font=\footnotesize] at (3,-3,1.25) {$2.5\text{ ft}$};
  \node[below, font=\footnotesize] at (1,4,0) {$2\text{ ft}$};
  \node[above right, font=\footnotesize] at (0,2,0) {$4\text{ ft}$};

  % Cables AB and AC
  \draw[thick, gray!80!black] (0,0,4) -- (3,-3,2.5);
  \draw[thick, gray!80!black] (0,0,4) -- (2,4,0);

  % Force Vectors FB and FC
  \draw[->, ultra thick, blue!80!black] (0,0,4) -- (1.8,-1.8,3.1) node[above left] {$F_B = 600\text{ lb}$};
  \draw[->, ultra thick, red!80!black] (0,0,4) -- (1.2,2.4,1.6) node[above right] {$F_C = 750\text{ lb}$};

  % Points A, B, C
  \filldraw[black] (0,0,4) circle (2pt) node[above right] {$A$};
  \filldraw[black] (3,-3,2.5) circle (2pt) node[above left] {$B$};
  \filldraw[black] (2,4,0) circle (2pt) node[below right] {$C$};
\end{tikzpicture}
""")
```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
### Solution Key — Problem 1 (Lecture Problem 5)
* $\mathbf{r}_{AB} = 3\mathbf{i} - 3\mathbf{j} - 1.5\mathbf{k}\text{ ft}, \quad |\mathbf{r}_{AB}| = 4.5\text{ ft} \implies \mathbf{F}_B = 600\left(\frac{3\mathbf{i} - 3\mathbf{j} - 1.5\mathbf{k}}{4.5}\right) = \{400\mathbf{i} - 400\mathbf{j} - 200\mathbf{k}\}\text{ lb}$
* $\mathbf{r}_{AC} = 2\mathbf{i} + 4\mathbf{j} - 4\mathbf{k}\text{ ft}, \quad |\mathbf{r}_{AC}| = 6\text{ ft} \implies \mathbf{F}_C = 750\left(\frac{2\mathbf{i} + 4\mathbf{j} - 4\mathbf{k}}{6}\right) = \{250\mathbf{i} + 500\mathbf{j} - 500\mathbf{k}\}\text{ lb}$
* $\mathbf{F}_R = \mathbf{F}_B + \mathbf{F}_C = \{650\mathbf{i} + 100\mathbf{j} - 700\mathbf{k}\}\text{ lb}$
* $F_R = \sqrt{650^2 + 100^2 + (-700)^2} = 960.5\text{ lb}$
* $\alpha = 47.4^\circ, \quad \beta = 84.0^\circ, \quad \gamma = 136.8^\circ$
:::

### Problem 2 (Lecture Problem 6)
Two cables attached to ring $A(0, -2\text{ m}, 4\text{ m})$ carry tensions of $600\text{ N}$ (directed toward $B(0, 0, 0)$) and $500\text{ N}$ (directed toward $C$, located at $x_C = 4\text{ m}$ and $8\text{ m}$ in the $+y$ direction from $A$, i.e., $C(4\text{ m}, 6\text{ m}, 0)$). Determine the magnitude and the coordinate direction angles of the resultant force.

```{python}
#| echo: false
render_tikz(r"""
\begin{tikzpicture}[x={(-0.55cm,-0.42cm)}, y={(1cm,0cm)}, z={(0cm,1cm)}, scale=0.68, >=stealth, line cap=round, line join=round, font=\small]
  % Axes
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (5.5,0,0) node[below left] {$x$};
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (0,7.2,0) node[right] {$y$};
  \draw[dashed, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (0,-2.8,0);
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (0,0,5.2) node[above] {$z$};

  % Coordinate construction lines

  \draw[dashed, gray] (4,0,0) -- (4,6,0) -- (0,6,0);
  \draw[dashed, gray] (4,-2,0) -- (4,6,0);
  \draw[dashed, gray] (0,-2,0) -- (4,-2,0);

  % Dimension labels

  \node[left, font=\footnotesize] at (0,-2,2) {$4\text{ m}$};

```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
### Solution Key — Problem 2 (Lecture Problem 6)
* $\mathbf{r}_{AB} = 0\mathbf{i} + 2\mathbf{j} - 4\mathbf{k}\text{ m}, \quad |\mathbf{r}_{AB}| = \sqrt{20} = 4.472\text{ m} \implies \mathbf{F}_{AB} = \{268.33\mathbf{j} - 536.66\mathbf{k}\}\text{ N}$
* $\mathbf{r}_{AC} = 4\mathbf{i} + 8\mathbf{j} - 4\mathbf{k}\text{ m}, \quad |\mathbf{r}_{AC}| = \sqrt{96} = 9.798\text{ m} \implies \mathbf{F}_{AC} = \{204.12\mathbf{i} + 408.25\mathbf{j} - 204.12\mathbf{k}\}\text{ N}$
* $\mathbf{F}_R = \{204.12\mathbf{i} + 676.58\mathbf{j} - 740.78\mathbf{k}\}\text{ N}$
* $F_R = 1024\text{ N}, \quad \alpha = 78.5^\circ, \quad \beta = 48.6^\circ, \quad \gamma = 136.3^\circ$
:::

### Problem 3 (Lecture Problem 7)
A rifle at $A$ ($z_A = 80\text{ m}$) is fired at a target at $B$ across a range with horizontal offsets $\Delta x = 160\text{ m}$, $\Delta y = 210\text{ m}$, and $\Delta z = -80\text{ m}$. If the speed of the bullet is $1800\text{ m/s}$, determine the rectangular form of the velocity vector $\mathbf{v}$.

```{python}
#| echo: false
render_tikz(r"""
\begin{tikzpicture}[x={(-0.55cm,-0.42cm)}, y={(1cm,0cm)}, z={(0cm,1cm)}, scale=0.75, >=stealth, line cap=round, line join=round, font=\small]
  % Shaded reference planes (scaled: 1 unit = 40 m -> dx=4, dy=5.25, dz=2)
  \fill[cyan!12] (0,0,0) -- (4,0,0) -- (4,5.25,0) -- (0,5.25,0) -- cycle;
  \fill[cyan!20] (0,0,0) -- (0,5.25,0) -- (0,5.25,2.2) -- (0,0,2.2) -- cycle;

  % Axes
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (5.4,0,0) node[below left] {$x$};
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (0,6.4,0) node[right] {$y$};
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (0,0,3.4) node[above] {$z$};

  % Plane outlines
  \draw[thick, gray!70!black] (4,0,0) -- (4,5.25,0) -- (0,5.25,0);
  \draw[thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,2.2) -- (0,5.25,2.2) -- (0,5.25,0);

  % Dimension labels
  \node[left, font=\footnotesize] at (0,0,1.1) {$80\text{ m}$};
  \node[below left, font=\footnotesize] at (4,2.6,0) {$210\text{ m}$};
  \node[below right, font=\footnotesize] at (2,5.25,0) {$160\text{ m}$};

  % Trajectory AB and Velocity vector v
  \draw[dashed, thick, gray!90!black] (0,0,2.2) -- (4,5.25,0);
  \draw[->, ultra thick, red!80!black] (0,0,2.2) -- (1.8,2.36,1.21) node[below left] {$\mathbf{v}$};

  % Points A and B
  \filldraw[black] (0,0,2.2) circle (2pt) node[above] {$A$};
  \filldraw[black] (4,5.25,0) circle (2pt) node[below] {$B$};
\end{tikzpicture}
""")
```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
### Solution Key — Problem 3 (Lecture Problem 7)
* $\mathbf{r}_{AB} = 160\mathbf{i} + 210\mathbf{j} - 80\mathbf{k}\text{ m} \quad (\text{or } -160\mathbf{i} + 210\mathbf{j} - 80\mathbf{k}\text{ m depending on origin choice})$
* $|\mathbf{r}_{AB}| = \sqrt{160^2 + 210^2 + (-80)^2} = \sqrt{76100} = 275.86\text{ m}$
* $\mathbf{v} = 1800\frac{\mathbf{r}_{AB}}{|\mathbf{r}_{AB}|} = \{1044\mathbf{i} + 1370\mathbf{j} - 522\mathbf{k}\}\text{ m/s}$
:::

### Problem 4 (Lecture Problem 8)
The slider travels along the guide rod $AB$ from $A(10\text{ m}, -8\text{ m}, 0)$ to $B(0, 16\text{ m}, 12\text{ m})$ with a velocity $v = 6\text{ m/s}$. Determine the rectangular representations of (a) the unit vector directed from $A$ toward $B$; and (b) the velocity vector $\mathbf{v}$.

```{python}
#| echo: false
render_tikz(r"""
\begin{tikzpicture}[x={(-0.55cm,-0.42cm)}, y={(1cm,0cm)}, z={(0cm,1cm)}, scale=0.78, >=stealth, line cap=round, line join=round, font=\small]
  % Scaled by 1/4: A(2.5, -2.0, 0), B(0, 4.0, 3.0)
  % Shaded planes
  \fill[cyan!12] (0,0,0) -- (2.5,0,0) -- (2.5,-2.0,0) -- (0,-2.0,0) -- cycle;
  \fill[cyan!18] (0,0,0) -- (0,4.0,0) -- (0,4.0,3.0) -- (0,0,3.0) -- cycle;

  % Plane outlines
  \draw[thick, gray!70!black] (2.5,0,0) -- (2.5,-2.0,0) -- (0,-2.0,0) -- (0,0,0);
  \draw[thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,3.0) -- (0,4.0,3.0) -- (0,4.0,0);

  % Axes
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (4.0,0,0) node[below left] {$x$};
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (0,5.2,0) node[right] {$y$};
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (0,0,4.2) node[above] {$z$};

  % Dimension labels
  \node[above left, font=\footnotesize] at (1.25,-2.0,0) {$8\text{ m}$};
  \node[below left, font=\footnotesize] at (2.5,-1.0,0) {$10\text{ m}$};
  \node[above right, font=\footnotesize] at (0,2.0,3.0) {$16\text{ m}$};
  \node[right, font=\footnotesize] at (0,4.0,1.5) {$12\text{ m}$};

  % Guide rod AB
  \draw[line width=3.5pt, gray!60!white] (2.5,-2.0,0) -- (0,4.0,3.0);
  \draw[thick, black] (2.5,-2.0,0) -- (0,4.0,3.0);

  % Slider block on rod at midpoint (1.25, 1.0, 1.5)
  \filldraw[fill=cyan!40!gray, draw=black, thick] (1.25,1.0,1.5) circle (5pt);

  % Velocity vector v
  \draw[->, ultra thick, red!80!black] (1.25,1.0,1.75) -- (0.35,3.16,2.83) node[above] {$\mathbf{v} = 6\text{ m/s}$};

  % Points A and B
  \filldraw[black] (2.5,-2.0,0) circle (2pt) node[left] {$A$};
  \filldraw[black] (0,4.0,3.0) circle (2pt) node[right] {$B$};
\end{tikzpicture}
""")
```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
### Solution Key — Problem 4 (Lecture Problem 8)
* $\mathbf{r}_{AB} = (0 - 10)\mathbf{i} + (16 - (-8))\mathbf{j} + (12 - 0)\mathbf{k} = -10\mathbf{i} + 24\mathbf{j} + 12\mathbf{k}\text{ m}$
* $|\mathbf{r}_{AB}| = \sqrt{(-10)^2 + 24^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{820} = 28.636\text{ m}$
* **(a)** $\mathbf{u}_{AB} = -0.349\mathbf{i} + 0.838\mathbf{j} + 0.419\mathbf{k}$
* **(b)** $\mathbf{v} = 6\mathbf{u}_{AB} = \{-2.10\mathbf{i} + 5.03\mathbf{j} + 2.51\mathbf{k}\}\text{ m/s}$
:::

### Problem 5 (Lecture Problem 9)
Two cables attached to the top of post $C(0, 0, 4\text{ ft})$ exert forces $F_1 = 100\text{ lb}$ (toward $A$, located in the $xy$-plane at radius $3\text{ ft}$ and angle $40^\circ$ from the $+y$ axis toward the $-x$ axis) and $F_2 = 81\text{ lb}$ (toward $B(4\text{ ft}, -7\text{ ft}, 0)$). Determine the magnitude and the coordinate direction angles of the resultant force.

```{python}
#| echo: false
render_tikz(r"""
\begin{tikzpicture}[x={(-0.55cm,-0.42cm)}, y={(1cm,0cm)}, z={(0cm,1cm)}, scale=0.72, >=stealth, line cap=round, line join=round, font=\small]
  % Axes
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (5.0,0,0) node[below left] {$x$};
  \draw[dashed, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (-3.0,0,0) node[above right] {$-x$};
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (0,4.5,0) node[right] {$y$};
  \draw[dashed, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (0,-5.5,0) node[left] {$-y$};
  \draw[->, thick, gray!70!black] (0,0,0) -- (0,0,5.2) node[above] {$z$};

  % Vertical Post OC
  \draw[line width=5pt, cyan!60!blue] (0,0,0) -- (0,0,4);
  \node[right, font=\footnotesize] at (0,0,2.0) {$4\text{ ft}$};

  % Point B(4, -5, 0) schematic for (4 ft, -7 ft, 0)
  \draw[dashed, gray] (3.5,0,0) -- (3.5,-5.0,0) -- (0,-5.0,0);
  \node[below left, font=\footnotesize] at (3.5,-2.5,0) {$7\text{ ft}$};
  \node[below right, font=\footnotesize] at (1.75,-5.0,0) {$4\text{ ft}$};

  % Point A(-1.93, 2.30, 0)
  \draw[dashed, thick, gray!80!black] (0,0,0) -- (-1.93,2.30,0) node[midway, above left, font=\footnotesize] {$3\text{ ft}$};
  \draw[->, green!50!black, thick] (0,1.8,0) to[bend right=20] node[above right, font=\footnotesize] {$40^\circ$} (-1.15,1.38,0);

  % Cables CA and CB
  \draw[thick, gray!80!black] (0,0,4) -- (-1.93,2.30,0);
  \draw[thick, gray!80!black] (0,0,4) -- (3.5,-5.0,0);

  % Forces F1 and F2
  \draw[->, ultra thick, red!80!black] (0,0,4) -- (-1.06,1.26,1.8) node[above right] {$F_1 = 100\text{ lb}$};
  \draw[->, ultra thick, blue!80!black] (0,0,4) -- (1.75,-2.5,2.0) node[above left] {$F_2 = 81\text{ lb}$};

  % Points A, B, C

  \filldraw[black] (3.5,-5.0,0) circle (2.2pt) node[above left] {$B$};
\end{tikzpicture}
""")
```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
### Solution Key — Problem 5 (Lecture Problem 9)
* $A(-3\sin 40^\circ, 3\cos 40^\circ, 0) = (-1.928\text{ ft}, 2.298\text{ ft}, 0)$
* $\mathbf{r}_{CA} = -1.928\mathbf{i} + 2.298\mathbf{j} - 4\mathbf{k}\text{ ft}, \quad |\mathbf{r}_{CA}| = 5\text{ ft} \implies \mathbf{F}_1 = \{-38.57\mathbf{i} + 45.96\mathbf{j} - 80.00\mathbf{k}\}\text{ lb}$
* $\mathbf{r}_{CB} = 4\mathbf{i} - 7\mathbf{j} - 4\mathbf{k}\text{ ft}, \quad |\mathbf{r}_{CB}| = 9\text{ ft} \implies \mathbf{F}_2 = \{36.00\mathbf{i} - 63.00\mathbf{j} - 36.00\mathbf{k}\}\text{ lb}$
* $\mathbf{F}_R = \{-2.57\mathbf{i} - 17.04\mathbf{j} - 116.00\mathbf{k}\}\text{ lb}$
* $F_R = 117.3\text{ lb}, \quad \alpha = 91.3^\circ, \quad \beta = 98.4^\circ, \quad \gamma = 171.6^\circ$
:::

### Problem 6 (Lecture Problem 10)

  \node[above right, font=\footnotesize] at (-1.5,0.5,0) {$4\text{ m}$};
  \node[above, font=\footnotesize] at (-0.75,1.0,0) {$6\text{ m}$};
  \node[above left, font=\footnotesize] at (2,-4.5,0) {$16\text{ m}$};
  \node[below left, font=\footnotesize] at (4,-2.25,0) {$18\text{ m}$};
